scope: Opt-in bounded contract-connected bottom groups; production defaults unchanged.

algorithm.eligible_groups: Supported lightweight proximity closure only; controlled-net owners, top-access parts and through-hole owners pin their entire group.
algorithm.search: Four deterministic corner alignments per eligible group; preserve incumbent and candidate indices. Require smaller envelope, same-face/through-hole clearance, full local placement contract and fanout checks.
algorithm.limits: Not a global solver or proof of assembly, thermal, height or return-path suitability. One group moved per candidate; unsupported contracts produce no new candidate. No hardware numeric limits invented.

binder_defect.first_screen: The old binder used the original footprint for mirrored bottom members of a top-primary pack. Final USB-JTAG U4/C2 and U4/C3 proximity failed at 2.31 and 3.57 mm against the existing authored 2 mm bound.
binder_defect.correction: Bind mirrored documents independently of primary pack face, with explicit membership and bottom-side validation. No constraint thresholds changed.

screen.timing_note: Screen timings are not promoted as uncontended benchmarks: a short geometry test overlapped the start. Full pipeline qualification and uncontended timing remain required.

qualification.source_audit: PASS: 69 C++ files, 75 constants, 156 registered transforms
qualification.visual_observation: Dense top and sparse bottom; relocated U28004/C28001/C28002/C28003 group visible below, central SoM reserve clear. Existing XT60/model-size limitation and unresolved hardware requirements prevent fabrication-readiness claims.
qualification.timing_limits: Single uncontended full-pipeline run, not a matched Python comparison. Compile time was not measured. Full log retains other authoring, schematic, audit and generation spans; do not treat listed subset as complete or subtract overlapping spans.

regressions.coverage: Both-board original placement contracts; unchanged incumbent geometry and variant indices; real USB-JTAG nonvacuous candidates; independent named-pad reflection; group rigidity; pinned bridge/controls; authored net identity through binder; exact operation-count receipts; deterministic candidates/receipts; pinned-owner suppression; CLI boundaries.

residual_risks: Hardware assembly/height/thermal and return-path requirements remain incompletely evidenced.
Routing is out of scope; this is not fabrication readiness.
Matched both-board Python baseline timing remains outstanding; no Python speedup is claimed here.
